recall.minute: The Transformer block has been refined. Post-norm Norm(h + F(h)) vs pre-norm h + F(Norm(h)): pre-norm keeps a clean identity path and trains stably at depth. RMSNorm scales by root-mean-square without mean subtraction: [2, −1, 3, 0] → LayerNorm [0.63, −1.26, 1.26, −0.63], RMSNorm [1.07, −0.53, 1.60, 0]. RoPE rotates each q, k pair by position × θᵢ (θᵢ = 10000^(−2i/d)); scores depend only on m − n (same score at (3,1), (10,8), (105,103)); generalises to longer context. GELU z·Φ(z), SiLU z·σ(z) (GELU(−0.5) ≈ −0.154). GLU multiplies a gate by content; SwiGLU uses a SiLU gate, three matrices with hidden width ~8d/3 so parameters match (134.2M each at d = 4096), and beats a GELU MLP. MoE: router softmax, top-k experts, renormalised weights; 8 experts top-2 → 25% active (1.07B stored, 268M used per token). Costs: all experts in memory; routing collapse prevented by an auxiliary load-balancing loss E·Σ fᵢPᵢ (1 = balanced) and capacity limits.
